label: Staged mutation (transaction writes held in a document's XATTRs until commit)
type: the mechanism by which sdk:distributed-transaction writes are technically stored inside a document's sdk:xattr fields and remain invisible to other actors until the transaction commits - the reason a document being staged is effectively locked from modification by other transactions until the attempt resolves or times out
note: Recurs across concept-docs/transactions.json (reliesOnMechanism from sdk:distributed-transaction, acquiresLockOn sdk:kv-operations, seeAlso sdk:xattr) and concept-docs/transactions-error-handling.json (tradesOffAgainst sdk:transaction-timeout, still extraction-layer at recurrence 1).
